description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for accessing Note entities in the notes application. It extends JpaRepository and includes a custom finder method to retrieve notes by owner ID.

classes.name: NoteRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Note entities, providing basic CRUD operations and a custom query method.

methods.name: findByOwnerId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notes associated with the specified owner ID.
